title: Form Charge on a Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) Moved Certificate, by What the New Term Is Written to Back
content:
**Rule.** A transfer form charge is added to the moved certificate fee under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44). A moved certificate is the state-change refiling a named insured orders after moving. The charge follows the certificate form the new term is written to back. That form is the financial responsibility filing recorded on the new Owner Auto Policy term or the new Named Non-Owner Policy term.

- **FR-44.** A new term written to back an FR-44 adds 10.00.
- **SR-22.** A new term written to back an SR-22 adds 2.00.
- **None.** A new term recorded as backing none adds no transfer form charge.

**Question answered.** *Whose record is read, the old term's or the new term's?* The new term's.
